message: Commit conventions live canonically in AGENTS.md; harnesses without AGENTS.md support get pointer rule files (.windsurf/.clinerules/.continue/.augment), Copilot gets a full copy in .github/copilot-instructions.md, Gemini imports via GEMINI.md. Subject limit set to 50 chars to match the repo commit-msg hook, not the 72 in the original draft. Not added to pack.py _HARNESSES — consumer distribution deferred.

TKT-11: split run-state read from write. core/run.py owns writing (markers, run.log, STOP, heartbeat.json); new core/agents.py owns reading (tkt agents, tkt run --status). Import direction is agents->run only. tkt agents is contractually backend-free (no adapter constructed) unless --enrich, so a TUI can poll it at 1Hz. Heartbeat runs on a daemon thread because invoke_harness blocks up to invocation_timeout (1h default) — loop-boundary beats could not distinguish working from crashed. Its absence, not its content, marks a run as no longer live. Added [run].state_dir so repos sharing one board can share one run-state root.

TKT-10: GitHub issue open/closed state is synced from [board].close_on (list of roles) inside GithubAdapter.transition via _sync_issue_state, after the board update. Unset = no extra gh calls; other adapters ignore the key. gh close reason must be the literal 'not planned' (space).

TKT-25: sync-pack mirrors consumer .claude/skills into registry-derived <dir>/skills surfaces; local names recorded as manifest local_skills so ownership is explicit and removed skills' .agents/skills copies are prunable (unprotect), not base-layer frozen; gitignored files and private skills never mirrored, fail closed if git errors.

TKT-53: run() consumes STOP after any clean _loop return (not finally, not dry-run) so a STOP is one-shot; a STOP sent mid-invocation is consumed when that invocation ends the run (gate or blocked outcome)
